questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file. An artist delivered a Blender shot: a tower of eight wooden crates knocked down by a swinging wrecking ball, simulated with rigid body physics. A reviewer's audit script fails the file because scene.rigidbody_world is None and no object has a rigid_body. Does that prove the simulation never ran? Say what the artist most likely did, which evidence in the file a reviewer should accept instead, and which call you would use to do that step in a headless (background) Blender.
questions.verified: skills/blender-animation/SKILL.md 'Hard runtime rules' item 7 (bpy.ops.rigidbody.bake_to_keyframes fails in background mode; use bpy_extras.anim_utils.bake_action) and skills/blender-animation/references/physics-sims.md 'Caching & baking'. Blender tool behaviour measured by the source author, not checkable on P:. The source eval note for this case: evidence of a simulation is either live rigid bodies or dense per-frame location keys with no rigid body world (bake, then remove the world).

questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file. With the DayZ Animation Tools plugin in Blender I made a two second wave for a DayZ character (right arm up, torso and head follow a little) and I am about to export it as a .txa for Workbench. My bone list holds EntityPosition, Pelvis, Spine, Spine1, Spine2, Neck, Head, the right arm chain, RightHand_Dummy, RightHandRing, RightHandPinky, LeftUpLeg and RightUpLeg. Which of these must I leave out of an action animation like this and why, which Export Type must the file declare, and which skeleton must the bone names match? Does the vanilla player bone list contain RightHandRing and RightHandPinky? Cite the vanilla file.
must_not_include: re:(RightHandRing|RightHandPinky|they|ring and pinky)[^.\n]{0,60}(do not|don't|does not|doesn't) exist in (the )?vanilla
questions.verified: P:/DZ/anims/cfg/skeletons.anim.xml:113 (EntityPosition), :115 (RightHand_Dummy), :230 (RightHandRing) and :247 (RightHandPinky), all in the player bone list; skills/blender-animation/SKILL.md 'DayZ handoff (.txa)' (action animations are spine-up: never key EntityPosition, Pelvis or the legs, and leave RightHand_Dummy out; Export Type ADD for action animations with Selected Bones Only; bone names must match OFP2_ManSkeleton). The source case said the ring and pinky bones have no parents in the vanilla skeleton; P: lists them, so the question checks the P: fact.
